data.action: 手捧白花立于光柱中，仰头望向新娘入场的方向，泪光与浅笑交织
data.camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, stained glass light rays, sacred bridal atmosphere
data.description: 【基地小教堂·正午】彩绘玻璃将正午阳光滤成圣洁的光柱。蕾娜身着纯白婚纱立于光柱中央，银白长发以白纱半掩，手捧白花与国旗色的缎带花束。她仰头望向走来的你，银灰眼眸里蓄满不敢相信般的泪光，贵族式的端庄仪态再也压不住唇角的颤抖——这位把葬礼献给无数士兵的女王，终于迎来了属于自己的婚礼进行曲。
data.lighting: 彩绘玻璃折射的圣洁彩色光柱笼罩全身
data.location: 基地附属小教堂彩绘玻璃长廊
data.promptProse: Vladilena Milize stands at the center of a small base chapel in a pure white wedding dress and delicate veil, clutching a bouquet of white flowers tied with national-flag ribbons. Colored stained-glass light falls across her figure as she looks up toward her approaching partner, tears glistening in her silver-grey eyes beneath a trembling noble smile. Sacred midday light fills the stone aisle behind the two-person ceremony.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 纯白花嫁的军装誓约·「无论战区是否存在，我愿永远与你同调」
